source_sql: SELECT CONCAT(first_name,' ',last_name) AS full_name FROM emp
gold_target_sql: SELECT first_name || ' ' || last_name AS full_name FROM emp

source_sql: CREATE TABLE t(id INT AUTO_INCREMENT, val DOUBLE, flag BIT(1))
gold_target_sql: CREATE TABLE t(id SERIAL, val DOUBLE PRECISION, flag BOOLEAN)

source_sql: SELECT * FROM t WHERE MATCH(title,content) AGAINST('keyword' IN BOOLEAN MODE)
gold_target_sql: SELECT * FROM t WHERE to_tsvector('english', title || ' ' || content) @@ to_tsquery('english', 'keyword')
gold_report_points: MySQL FULLTEXT MATCH → PostgreSQL to_tsvector + to_tsquery

gold_target_sql: CREATE TYPE order_status AS ENUM('pending','shipped','done'); CREATE TABLE orders(id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, status order_status, created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM age(date1, date2)) * 12 + EXTRACT(MONTH FROM age(date1, date2)) FROM t

source_sql: UPDATE emp SET salary = (SELECT AVG(salary) FROM emp WHERE dept_id = emp.dept_id) WHERE dept_id IN (SELECT id FROM dept WHERE name='IT')
gold_target_sql: UPDATE emp SET salary = (SELECT AVG(salary) FROM emp WHERE dept_id = emp.dept_id) WHERE dept_id IN (SELECT id FROM dept WHERE name='IT')
gold_report_points: 相关子查询 UPDATE 两端兼容

source_sql: SELECT CONNECT_BY_ISLEAF AS is_leaf, LEVEL AS lvl, name FROM emp START WITH manager_id IS NULL CONNECT BY PRIOR id = manager_id
gold_target_sql: WITH RECURSIVE emp_tree AS (SELECT id, name, manager_id, 0 AS lvl, false AS is_leaf FROM emp WHERE manager_id IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT e.id, e.name, e.manager_id, t.lvl+1, NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM emp WHERE manager_id=e.id) FROM emp e JOIN emp_tree t ON e.manager_id = t.id) SELECT is_leaf, lvl, name FROM emp_tree
gold_report_points: CONNECT BY 层次查询 → WITH RECURSIVE 递归 CTE
CONNECT_BY_ISLEAF → EXISTS 判断叶子节点

source_sql: SELECT e.name, d.dname, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM emp WHERE dept_id = e.dept_id) AS dept_cnt, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY e.dept_id ORDER BY e.salary DESC) AS sal_rank FROM emp e, dept d WHERE e.dept_id = d.id(+) AND e.hire_date > ADD_MONTHS(sysdate, -24)
gold_target_sql: SELECT e.name, d.dname, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM emp WHERE dept_id = e.dept_id) AS dept_cnt, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY e.dept_id ORDER BY e.salary DESC) AS sal_rank FROM emp e LEFT JOIN dept d ON e.dept_id = d.id WHERE e.hire_date > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '24 months'
gold_report_points: 相关子查询 + 窗口函数组合
